newsitem.title: USA: Alcohol Sensors names new board member.
newsitem.headline: Alcohol Sensors names new board member.

text.p: Alcohol Sensors International Ltd said Tuesday it had appointed Michael Ghazarian to its board, replacing one of two members who resigned because of serious illness.

Ghazarian is the managing director of Digital Vehicle Security Systems Ltd, which recently signed a $360 million contract to purchase and sell 1.6 million of Alcohol Sensor's SENS-O-LOCK devices in Europe.
Board members George Berger and Leon Pasqua announced their resignations on Tuesday, citing illness.
